description: This file defines a reusable UI Button component using the Lightning.js framework. It specifies properties like label, variant, width, and height, and manages visual states and styles based on the variant. It includes templates for rendering the button with hover effects and handles user interactions such as focus and pointer events.

classes.name: UIButton
classes.description: A Lightning.js component representing a customizable button with different variants, styling, and hover effects.

methods.name: bgColor
methods.description: Computes the background color based on the button's variant.

methods.name: txtColor
methods.description: Determines the text color based on the variant.

methods.name: effects
methods.description: Returns the visual effects applied to the button based on its variant.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Handles focus event; increases hover alpha for visual feedback.

methods.name: unfocus
methods.description: Handles unfocus event; resets hover alpha.

methods.name: pointerover
methods.description: Handles pointer over event; shows hover effects.

methods.name: pointerout
methods.description: Handles pointer out event; hides hover effects.
